44993.title: Add Part button hidden on Complete, Invoiced, or Paid
provenance: This is the expected behaviour as per epic SV-9315 and story SV-9316 (Story 1, Add Part Button on Work Order Lines) and the Inline Add and Edit Parts on Work Order Lines specification version 16, section S1-N1, read on 31 August 2026.

before.custom_preconds:
1. Your user has the 'Work Order Line - Create and Edit' permission enabled. To check it: open “Settings”, click “Roles & Permissions” in the sidebar, then click the pencil on the role your user is on, and look for “Work Order Line - Create and Edit”.
2. In the top menu click “Work Orders”, then open a work order whose status is Complete, Invoiced, Paid, Declined, or Imported (click its row). Open its “Lines” tab. Each work order line has its own Parts section beneath it: the “Add Part” button sits in that section, and every part already on the line has an “edit” control at the right-hand end of its row — that control stays invisible until you move the mouse over the row.
before.custom_steps: 1. Open a work order in each of those statuses and look at the Parts section of its lines.
before.custom_expected:
1. The “Add Part” button is not displayed on any work order line when the status is Complete, Invoiced, Paid, Declined, or Imported.

NOTE FOR THE TESTER: only the Paid status exists on this test system. Check the button on a Paid work order; Complete, Invoiced, Declined and Imported cannot be set up here, so mark this case Blocked and say which status you were able to check - do not pass it on Paid alone.

---
This is the expected behaviour as per epic SV-9315 and story SV-9316 (Story 1, Add Part Button on Work Order Lines) and the Inline Add and Edit Parts on Work Order Lines specification version 16, section S1-N1, read on 31 August 2026.
Last checked against build v26.35.6-598cc8a on 9/1/2026.

AUTOMATION: READY

44994.title: Edit control hidden on Complete, Invoiced, or Paid
provenance: This is the expected behaviour as per epic SV-9315 and story SV-9316 (Story 1, Add Part Button on Work Order Lines) and the Inline Add and Edit Parts on Work Order Lines specification version 16, section S1-N2, read on 31 August 2026.

before.custom_preconds:
1. Your user has the 'Work Order Line - Create and Edit' permission enabled. To check it: open “Settings”, click “Roles & Permissions” in the sidebar, then click the pencil on the role your user is on, and look for “Work Order Line - Create and Edit”.
2. In the top menu click “Work Orders”, then open a work order whose status is Complete, Invoiced, Paid, Declined, or Imported and that has at least one part on a line (click its row). Open its “Lines” tab. Each work order line has its own Parts section beneath it: the “Add Part” button sits in that section, and every part already on the line has an “edit” control at the right-hand end of its row — that control stays invisible until you move the mouse over the row.
before.custom_steps: 1. Open a work order in each of those statuses and hover/focus its existing part lines.
before.custom_expected:
1. The Edit control is not displayed on part lines when the status is Complete, Invoiced, Paid, Declined, or Imported.

NOTE FOR THE TESTER: only the Paid status exists on this test system. Check the control on a Paid work order; Complete, Invoiced, Declined and Imported cannot be set up here, so mark this case Blocked and say which status you were able to check - do not pass it on Paid alone.

---
This is the expected behaviour as per epic SV-9315 and story SV-9316 (Story 1, Add Part Button on Work Order Lines) and the Inline Add and Edit Parts on Work Order Lines specification version 16, section S1-N2, read on 31 August 2026.
Last checked against build v26.35.6-598cc8a on 9/1/2026.

AUTOMATION: READY
